purpose: God Molecule deterministic hybrid environment generation
principle: voxel/world-seed structure provides deterministic macro layout; Gaussian splats provide captured physical appearance; Blender/OpenUSD provides canonical scene assembly and animation.

voxel_world.name: worldgen
voxel_world.role: procedural terrain, climate and world-history seed generation

capture_reconstruction.name: colmap
capture_reconstruction.role: camera poses and sparse/dense reconstruction input

scene_assembly.name: blender
scene_assembly.role: canonical scene assembly, camera, lighting, animation and render

scene_assembly.name: openusd
scene_assembly.role: scene interchange and layered environment assembly

recipe: recover camera poses with COLMAP or Meshroom
train/build Gaussian scene with Nerfstudio + gsplat
validate splat bounds, density and camera coverage
project/align splat scene to world-seed coordinates
assemble voxel geometry + splat appearance + canonical Mars in Blender/OpenUSD
record seed, source hashes, backend versions and output hashes

fallback_policy.no_gpu: use voxel/mesh proxy and defer Gaussian training; never fake a completed splat
fallback_policy.splat_failure: retain photogrammetry/mesh reconstruction and continue scene assembly
fallback_policy.reconstruction_failure: retain deterministic voxel scene and source plates
fallback_policy.render_oom: reduce proxy complexity or tile/segment the render; never substitute a telemetry frame for a creative final without explicit artifact labeling
